releaseNotes:
PotFlix v2.1.4:
• Fixed TMDB API: Restored general default API key so poster & metadata fetching works reliably out of the box
• Custom TMDB API Key Setting: Users can now enter their own free TMDB API key or v4 token under Settings > Metadata & TMDB
• Improved network interceptor to target TMDB endpoints without affecting AList or other CDN requests
• All v2.1.3 improvements: GPU hardware acceleration, pull-to-refresh, Continue Watching management
